Alice Chen: Hey @security-team quick question — we have a tiny subset (~0.04%) of prod embedding calls that suddenly produce nonsense. To debug I need to capture ~200 full request+response bodies (only those failing). Can we get a short-lived exception for me + Marco to access an S3 path with the raw payloads?
Marco Li: I can pre-filter and only upload the failing IDs. I can also hash user ids, but truncating the prompt breaks repro. Need the full prompt/token pair for a handful of samples.
Jess Carter: Hi @Alice @Marco — we can do ephemeral access, not blanket perms. Requirements: 1) create an INF ticket with exact scope + retention, 2) list of approvers and people who need access, 3) a redaction plan (what keys/headers to scrub), 4) storage path and TTL. Can you paste the proposed redaction rules here?
Alice Chen: Thanks. Proposed rules: hash `user_id` header with HMAC-SHA256 + salt, redact emails/phones in payload, redact any field named `token` or `access_token`. Example regex for emails: ```[^\s]+@[^\s]+``` — we'll also run a deterministic per-user hash before upload. TTL proposed = 48h.
Dinesh Patel: Don't rely on a single regex for tokens or PII. For safety we want pipeline-level key redaction + header stripping. Suggested filters: ```redact_keys = ["prompt","user_message","token","access_token"]
strip_headers = ["Authorization","Cookie","X-Api-Key"]
pii_masking = {"email": "REDACTED_EMAIL", "phone": "REDACTED_PHONE"}
``` Also: hash user ids with HMAC using the project KMS key; do not store plaintext identifiers in metadata.
Marco Li: Ok — I'll add the `--mask-emails` and `--strip-headers` flags to the upload script and make sure user ids are HMACed. We'll only upload the 200 failing call IDs from the selector. Storage: s3://redwood-debug/prod/embeddings/INF-4521/ — will be encrypted and limited to the approval group.
Jess Carter: Good. When you create the ticket include: sample selector query, exact S3 path, list of people, retention TTL, and acceptance criteria (how you'll confirm PII removed). We require lifecycle delete after TTL and no manual download except via console with MFA.
AuditBot: auditbot: created ticket INF-4521 "Prod embedding repro sample capture" and assigned to @security-eng.
Alice Chen: Ticket created (INF-4521). Added sample selector, upload script, and the redaction snippets above. Access requested for: Alice Chen, Marco Li, Chen Wu, and two ML engineers (names in ticket).
Jess Carter: Approval pending IAM group creation. Once SRE has lifecycle + bucket policy in place we can grant 48h access. Note: Security will do a quick review of the first 10 samples to verify redaction before access is broadened.
SRE Ops: Will create the IAM group `inf-4521-debuggers`, attach kms:Encrypt permissions for the bucket, and add lifecycle rule to expire objects after 48 hours. Will post ARN & policy here when done.
Jess Carter: Approved for ephemeral access once SRE confirms infra setup. Please keep the sample set minimal and delete immediately after verification. :white_check_mark:
